verdict.rationale: React's first-party docs state that on the server React can start streaming HTML while still fetching data, progressively filling in content before any JavaScript loads (react-docs-6). This is supported by server rendering via Node (react-gh-2) and hydrateRoot for hydrating react-dom/server output (react-docs-9). Missing for 10: no in-depth API documentation of the streaming APIs (e.g., renderToPipeableStream, Suspense boundaries) in the pack, no independent or hands-on corroboration of perceived-load gains, and the docs steer full apps toward frameworks for this setup (react-docs-4).
